function: CVAE-M generates the phase shifts of the multi-layer UAV-mounted SIM to maximize uplink network capacity, replacing the iterative LBL-IPSO optimization (pp. 19-21).
system: Uplink, 3 UAV-SIMs at 50 m, each with one receive antenna behind an L-layer stacked SIM of N=36 meta-atoms per layer; 5 users; 28 GHz (pp. 10, 23).
method: Conditional VAE with capacity-aware loss, trained on LBL-IPSO solutions (supervised distillation, about 80,000 entries); association and UAV position by convex optimization with CVX (pp. 16, 21, 23).
data_channel: Own simulator: correlated Rayleigh fading with free-space path loss, Rayleigh-Sommerfeld inter-layer responses; training set of about 80,000 own simulated entries (pp. 11-12, 23).
test_conditions: Dataset spans varied UAV-SIM positions, user positions and channels; evaluated for 1-6 layers, 16-64 meta-atoms, 3-8 users, K=8 with M=5; no held-out scenario stated (pp. 23-28).
baselines: Non-learned: LBL-IPSO, PSO, DE, random and uniform deployment, no SIM. Learned: only CVAE with standard loss, an ablation of the proposed model (pp. 23-26).
metrics: Network capacity in bps versus iterations, layers, meta-atoms, users; CVAE training loss; average execution time in seconds (pp. 24-29).
complexity: Orders: LBL-IPSO O(4N^2 M L^2 kmax), CVAE generation O(NL), training O(Dn zn Ln); measured average execution time 222-226 s for CVAE versus 215-245 s for LBL-IPSO (pp. 22, 29).
q1_support: p. 12: "a quasi-static flat-fading model is adopted for all channels" with "correlated Rayleigh fading distribution"; custom simulator with free-space path loss (p. 23). Missing: any 3GPP TR 38.901/38.811, COST 2100, DeepMIMO model or measured data.
q2_support: p. 23: "comprehensive parameter variations including UAV-SIM positions, user positions, and channel environments" in training data. Missing: no held-out scenario is stated, and it is not said whether the CVAE is retrained for K=8, M=5 (p. 26) or other L and N.
q3_support: p. 23: "two classical evolutionary algorithms, which are differential evolution (DE) and particle swarm optimization (PSO)", plus RD, UD and LBL-IPSO are non-learned. Missing: no earlier learned method; p. 26 compares "the standard CVAE loss function and our improved formulation", an ablation.
q4_support: p. 22: "In the generation phase, the required complexity is O(N L)"; Table II gives O(4N^2 M L^2 kmax) and O(Dn zn Ln); p. 29 reports average execution time of 222 to 226 seconds for the CVAE.
q5_support: p. 23: "a dataset consisting of approximately 80,000 distinct entries collected from various simulation scenarios", own simulations. Missing: no code or data link or DOI anywhere, and no public channel dataset.
notes: Included: CVAE-M is a learned generator of SIM phase shifts (pp. 19-21); user association and UAV placement are solved by convex optimization, not learning (pp. 16-18); the SIM is a stacked RIS, so the single-antenna exclusion does not apply (p. 10). Area 3 chosen because the learned part only configures the SIM phase shifts. Area 6 considered since the SIMs are UAV-mounted at a fixed 50 m height (p. 23), but no aerial resource, power or beam control is learned and the paper never mentions NTN; reviewer to confirm. CVAE results appear as CVAE Model in Figs. 3 to 7. The paper does not say whether the CVAE is retrained for each L, N, K, M.
